name: OCP coat (ABU cut) with blank name tape
size_basis: Outline traced from images/base/ABU_male.webp (581x719 px) at 0.0474 in/px, chosen so the coat is 29.96 in long. No real garment was measured. Sleeve cap and width were then modified by script for patch room, and the torso was widened x1.2 (estimate) so the purchase-description chest pocket fits. Length 29.96 in is about a Large Regular back length (30 in, GL/PD 14-04B Table VIIA; Medium Regular is 29-1/2); the Air Force wears this same Army OCP coat (DAFI 36-2903, which CAPR 39-1 7.1 points to) - that identity is an inference.

component_sources.note: Component sizes below are from the Army purchase description GL/PD 14-04B (rev B, Mar 2023; Detail Spec, Coat, Army Combat Uniform OCP), para 3.7 and Table VIIA, M/L/XL/XXL. Read by the coordination chat and relayed to this chat; rev B differs from rev A only in the upper sleeve pocket width (4-1/2 in, was 5). They are real inches in the coat's own coordinates only if the length scale is right.
not_drawn: cuff tab 2-1/8 x 3-1/8 (cuff tab rectangles removed on request)
left sleeve pencil pocket 2-3/8 wide, 2 channels (pen pockets removed on request; CAPR 39-1 7.1.1.1.2 makes it optional)
component_sources.chosen_size: Large Regular (back length 30 in); finished half chest 24-1/4 in is a flat measurement and is not comparable to the worn-view torso width drawn here

collar_slots.note: angle_deg: SVG rotate() convention (clockwise positive) to apply to an insignia whose long axis is vertical. cadet_* slots: cadet officer grade / cadet NCO metal chevron, centred 1 in from the collar FRONT edge, long axis parallel to it (cadet_axis = two points along that axis). officer_*: officer grade, centred 1 in from the collar BOTTOM edge, long axis perpendicular to it. size_in.along is measured along the long axis. bbox is the axis-aligned box of the rotated slot, also exposed as landmarks collar_*_zone_*. Right/left = wearer's.

landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; polygons are [[x,y]...]; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box

chest_pocket.note: top edge rises toward the zipper; mirrored

beret_nbb_front.source: MEASURED on assets/refs/nbb/nbb-site-1.jpg (2024 NBB group photo, the front six heads, 57-62 px across), by base-art/beret-nbb-measure.js: beret width 0.884 head widths (heads 1-3 against grass), crown 3.282 in above the headband corner and the silhouette (heads 1-3), drape 1.436 in below the band (mean of heads 1-4; 5 and 6 unreadable in dark hair), device 0.146 x 0.171 head widths and its centre at u 0.724, 0.226 head widths above the band (all six). ESTIMATED: the inch scale (head 7.2 in across, as the other caps), the headband strip height 0.2 in, the device gold (the tree gold #f2d40a: the photo device is 8-13 px and blends with the navy); the device shape from national-blue-beret-insignia-commons.jpg. Navy #151932 = median of the crown on heads 1-3 (#151932, #1b1b34, #0a1124); the Vanguard CAP96029 product photo reads #040607 (under-exposed, near black). No cloth flash shows on the worn berets: none drawn. u: 0 at the drape edge (picture left = wearer's right) .. 1 at the wearer's left side. CAPR 39-1 6.2.3, ICL 25-02 9.2.3; LIVE13-ART 1

edge_view.note: The shoulder pocket seen from the front (edge-on): the flat sleeve view narrowed to scale about the pocket centre line, turned by tilt_deg about the pivot (right: clockwise, left: counter-clockwise), its outer face on the sleeve edge. pivot_*_in are in sheet inches; visible_*: the silhouette near the pocket in the pocket frame as [v down from the pivot, u toward the centre line], 0.04 in inside it. Read by the engine instead of its own constants.

National Blue Beret, front view as worn (group hat-beret-nbb-front; landmarks beret_nbb_front, beret_nbb_front_device, beret_nbb_front_headband): headband straight across the forehead, top draped over the right ear, Blue Beret device (CAPR 39-1 6.2.3; NBB graduates with the ABU/OCP at the unit level, ICL 25-02 9.2.3); shape, device size and position measured on the 2024 NBB group photo (base-art/beret-nbb-measure.js); no back view
